# [AutoPerf F023] Avoid disabled timers for infinite session loads

<!-- Thank you for submitting a pull request to our repo. -->

below to ensure a smooth review and merge process for your PR. -->

<!-- Once all that is done, you're ready to go. Open the PR with the content below. -->

Skip disabled load timers only for explicit infinite I/O timeouts.

## Description

**Qualified opt-in allocation proposal; not merge-ready.** Skip the disabled load timer only when the existing documented `IOTimeout` is exactly `Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan`. Keep the fresh linked CTS,caller linkage/disposal,finite/default deadline,exception/log distinction and loaded-state behavior. F024 `CommitAsync` is unchanged.

Source:[9068cc0d115e7e6a931ac836cc41c62767a2c57f](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/commit/9068cc0d115e7e6a931ac836cc41c62767a2c57f),independent baseline`37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5`. Source diff:2files,product+4/-1,new focused test+145/-0. No public/protected declaration,default,TFM,dependency or visibility change.

**Reproducible evidence:** [immutable F023 capsule](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/59cce28b86ba0b31b231bed63b94e4033c129186/F023),[runnable BenchmarkDotNet project](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/59cce28b86ba0b31b231bed63b94e4033c129186/F023/harness/AutoPerf.Benchmarks.csproj),[all comparisons/controls/cold observations](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/59cce28b86ba0b31b231bed63b94e4033c129186/F023/comparison.md),[exact recorded commands and outcomes](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/59cce28b86ba0b31b231bed63b94e4033c129186/F023/validation-commands.md). Tracking:https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/issues/135.

| Actual public wrapper | Original B/op | Selected B/op | Observed paired time reduction %,1/2/3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Fresh infinite,miss,no caller |440|344|40.34 /28.30 /38.16|
| Fresh infinite,hit,no caller |856|760|22.60 /22.02 /21.12|
| Fresh infinite,miss,cancelable caller |456|360|34.08 /26.54 /31.85|
| Fresh infinite,hit,cancelable caller |872|776|18.86 /19.81 /15.57|

All4 target profiles save96 B/op in every pair. Default/finite and already-loaded allocation controls are unchanged. **No default-configuration/application-speedup claim:** the VM is shared,default/control timings also move materially,and finite paths traverse the new comparison guard. Adverse default/loaded timing pairs and slower first-observed calls are retained. The wrapper includes actual session creation/load,real distributed-memory cache and public value consumption;not HTTP,remote provider latency or production-frequency evidence.

**Actual validation (all commands/details linked above):**

```powershell
Set-Location 'C:\src\aspnetcore'
. .\activate.ps1
& 'C:\src\aspnetcore\.dotnet\dotnet.exe' 'test' 'C:\src\aspnetcore\src\Middleware\Session\test\Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.Tests.csproj' '--no-restore' '-c' 'Release' '-f' 'net12.0' '-m:2' '-nr:false' '-p:UseSharedCompilation=false' '-p:UseIisNativeAssets=false' '--filter' 'FullyQualifiedName~Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.SessionTests' '--logger' 'trx;LogFileName=owning.trx' '--results-directory' 'C:\Users\jaslawin\.copilot\session-state\a24edcfd-1bb9-4160-afce-6ba54b1b7f00\files\autoperf-runs\F023\validation\original-existing' '-v' 'minimal'
# original-existing:actual runner exit0;26 passed,0 expected allocation red,0 skipped.
Set-Location 'C:\src\aspnetcore'
. .\activate.ps1
& 'C:\src\aspnetcore\.dotnet\dotnet.exe' 'test' 'C:\src\aspnetcore\src\Middleware\Session\test\Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.Tests.csproj' '--no-restore' '-c' 'Release' '-f' 'net12.0' '-m:2' '-nr:false' '-p:UseSharedCompilation=false' '-p:UseIisNativeAssets=false' '--filter' 'FullyQualifiedName~Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.SessionTests|FullyQualifiedName~Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.DistributedSessionTests' '--logger' 'trx;LogFileName=owning.trx' '--results-directory' 'C:\Users\jaslawin\.copilot\session-state\a24edcfd-1bb9-4160-afce-6ba54b1b7f00\files\autoperf-runs\F023\validation\original-resource-characterization' '-v' 'minimal'
# original-resource-characterization:actual runner exit1;29 passed,1 expected allocation red,0 skipped.
Set-Location 'C:\src\aspnetcore'
. .\activate.ps1
& 'C:\src\aspnetcore\.dotnet\dotnet.exe' 'test' 'C:\src\aspnetcore\src\Middleware\Session\test\Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.Tests.csproj' '--no-restore' '-c' 'Release' '-f' 'net12.0' '-m:2' '-nr:false' '-p:UseSharedCompilation=false' '-p:UseIisNativeAssets=false' '--filter' 'FullyQualifiedName~Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.SessionTests|FullyQualifiedName~Microsoft.AspNetCore.Session.DistributedSessionTests' '--logger' 'trx;LogFileName=owning.trx' '--results-directory' 'C:\Users\jaslawin\.copilot\session-state\a24edcfd-1bb9-4160-afce-6ba54b1b7f00\files\autoperf-runs\F023\validation\selected-owning' '-v' 'minimal'
# selected-owning:actual runner exit0;30 passed,0 expected allocation red,0 skipped.
```

`LoadAsync_InfiniteTimeoutAvoidsTimerAllocation` is red before/green after. Both individual `LoadAsync_InfiniteTimeoutPreservesCallerCancellation(canceledBeforeLoad: True/False)` rows and `LoadAsync_InfiniteTimeoutPreservesOwnedTokenLifetime` pass on original/selected. Existing hosted tests also ran. Each actual frozen owner additionally passes8 public wrappers/16 value contracts/10 real caller/deadline/token-lifetime/error producers. Zero timeout preserves its inherent entry-order race;no exact ordering claim.

**Measurement/provenance:** one common98-file harness closure,only Session DLL/PDB differ;3/3 comparisons permanently closed,18native profiles/48raw means independently recomputed/12cold observations. SDK12.0.100-alpha.1.26557.102,runtime12.0.0-alpha.1.26562.105,C#13,server GC,settings-preserving emitter and observed Normal/Normal/65535 point checks;no OS changes. Actual source/PE/PDB/closure witnesses,196live native bindings/100paths and60runtime bindings audited. Fresh physically relocated project also built/characterized without timing. Binary omissions have hashes;portable copied-text audit cannot rehash those omitted images or prove complete compiler provenance/coverage.

**Boundaries retained:** measured DLLs were baseline+patch before source commit,not built at the final commit;selected12file current-default parity is not newer-default SDK integration;unit/BDN absolute allocation totals are different callers/JIT/consumer boundaries;initial harness compile failure and runtime-only CA1416 warning retained. No full repository,pack,other-OS,release-readiness or upstream-acceptance claim. No API approval is implied.

Fixes #135
actualTrackingIssueBody:
Independent retained AutoPerf finding **F023**: `DistributedSession.LoadAsync` creates an owned linked CTS and calls `CancelAfter(IOTimeout)` per uncached asynchronous load.

**Scoped proposal, not merge-ready:** keep finite/default deadlines and fresh token ownership. Skip `CancelAfter` only for the existing documented exact `Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan` option. F024 `CommitAsync` is not changed.

Source: [9068cc0d115e7e6a931ac836cc41c62767a2c57f](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/commit/9068cc0d115e7e6a931ac836cc41c62767a2c57f).
Immutable evidence and runnable BDN project: [F023](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/59cce28b86ba0b31b231bed63b94e4033c129186/F023).

Three comparisons are permanently closed:18 native profiles,48 warm rows,12 separate first-observed observations. Every fresh infinite-timeout profile saves96 B/op;primary miss440->344,hit856->760. Default/finite and already-loaded allocation controls are unchanged. Observed timings/control drift are fully retained,not an application/default-configuration/remote-I/O gain claim.

Original:26 existing passes;expanded30 rows have29 passes and only the expected87552vs87552 allocation red. Selected:30/30 passes,0skips. Each actual frozen owner:8 public wrappers/16 value contracts/10 real caller/deadline/lifetime/error producers. Fresh relocated project built/characterized without additional timing. Shared VM,settings preserved at observed points;no dedicated-environment claim.

No public/protected declaration,default,TFM,dependency or assembly-boundary change. Full results,actual commands and source/PE/PDB/closure/omission limits are in the immutable evidence. This fork-only tracking issue does not assert upstream acceptance or release readiness.
